definitions.eligible: Finite aggregate target and complete_reference=true. Provisional and coverage-limited flags are reported, not silently excluded.
definitions.strictly_eligible: Eligible and both provisional=false and coverage_limited=false explicitly.
definitions.requested_passages: Passages in the supplied corpus metadata within selected splits; null when no metadata was supplied.
definitions.observed_steps: Only segments present in the labels file. Completely absent passages or absent segments have unknown segment counts.
definitions.pairwise_repeatability: All unordered pairs of finite repeat scores within each observed step, including incomplete steps with at least two scores; pooled by pair count.
definitions.median_consistency: Repeat scores compared with their own within-step median, using only complete steps with at least two repeats. The median includes the scored repeat; this is descriptive and not an independent prediction test.
definitions.family_weighting: Average available step metrics equally within each family, then families equally, matching equation evaluation. Families without the requested metric are excluded and counted.
definitions.provisional_fraction: Provisional observed steps divided by all observed steps. Unknown status is counted separately.

interpretation: Repeatability of Jev-based reference scores does not establish human working-memory truth or validity.
Observed disagreement describes this reference procedure; it is not a hard ceiling on equation performance against an aggregated reference.
Variants, clauses, and repeats are correlated within passages and families; pair counts are not independent sample counts.
Coverage counts are exact for supplied metadata and observed labels; requested counts for completely absent segments cannot be recovered from aggregated labels alone.
The final test must remain unopened until the equation and evaluation are frozen. This flag records inclusion, not proof of a prior freeze.
